messages:
Alex Chen: quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — I captured remediation items and handoffs below. want to confirm owners/timelines so we can roll this into next sprint. TL;DR: token validation fixes, audit-query improvements, secrets rotation checklist.

Morgan Lee: thanks alex. can you paste the list here? i skimmed the doc but missed ownership for a couple items.

Alex Chen: sure. copy/paste condensed:
- A1: token-issuer validation edge case (race on refresh) -> owner: Morgan -> due: 2026-04-08
- A2: permission mapping unit tests for service accounts -> owner: Sara -> due: 2026-04-12
- A3: audit log query + retention check (faster slices) -> owner: Jules -> due: 2026-04-05
- A4: secrets rotation playbook + automate TTL check -> owner: Morgan/Sara -> due: 2026-04-20
- A5: recurring incident pattern detection (token expiry cascade) -> owner: SecurityBot + Jules -> due: 2026-04-15

Sara Patel: noted. i'll take A2 and help with A4 automation. tagging @Morgan for the joint item.

Morgan Lee: +1 on A4. for A1 i think the quick fix is to add an idempotent refresh guard and an extra validation at the token cache lookup. estimate 2d for patch + 1d for test/deploy. ok for 2026-04-08.

Jules Rivera: i'll own A3 and the pattern-detection piece for A5. for audit queries i want to add an index on event_time and precompute a 24h aggregated table. quick query prototype:
```sql
SELECT actor_id, event_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM audit_events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY actor_id, event_type
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
I'll pair with infra to ensure retention windows are applied.

SecurityBot: action-assigned: A5 -> Jules Rivera, A3 -> Jules Rivera. Creating Jira tasks: INF-1429, INF-1430.

Alex Chen: great. a couple of governance notes from the postmortem: (1) owners must set an explicit ETA on the Jira ticket, (2) add a short verification step in the postmortem doc once complete (what was changed, how validated), (3) recurring incidents: we'll set a quarterly audit to detect token drift across services.

Sara Patel: for verification steps i propose a minimal test matrix in the PR description: unit test + integration test + an archival audit query verifying rotations. i can draft a template.

Morgan Lee: can we also add a lightweight alert when token validation latency spikes? saw two instances where our cache misses coincided with token rejection floods. alert threshold idea: 95th pct token validation latency > 200ms for 5m.

Jules Rivera: +1 on the alert. i'll add an observability ticket and a dashboard panel. also will script a nightly job that emits stats to the incident metrics index; that'll feed the recurrence detector.

Alex Chen: nice. for ownership handoff: can each of you drop the Jira ID and ETA in this thread once they're created? i'll compile for the exec update.

Morgan Lee: INF-1441 created for A1, ETA 2026-04-08. PR will reference runbook change: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/authz-token-refresh

Sara Patel: INF-1442 for A2, ETA 2026-04-12. INF-1443 for A4 automation (shared with Morgan), ETA 2026-04-20.

Jules Rivera: INF-1430 (A3) ETA 2026-04-05. INF-1444 (A5 recurrence detection) ETA 2026-04-15. putting dashboards link in ticket.

SecurityBot: reminder: weekly remediation standup created -> #incidents-remediation-wkly on Thursdays 10:00 PT. automated reminders will post.

Alex Chen: last bit — recurring pattern note: root cause was an interplay between short-lived tokens + opportunistic perm drift during deploys. Action: add a canary that validates permissions after rollout for critical routes for 24h.

Morgan Lee: canary sounds good. i'll propose a small change to the deploy pipeline to run a permission smoke test post-deploy. estimate 1d.

Sara Patel: i'll draft the smoke test cases. will share by EOD.

Alex Chen: thanks all. i'll update the postmortem doc with these tickets and schedule the first remediation standup. :thumbsup:

Jules Rivera: thanks — i'll drop short notes in the Jira tickets for cross-team handoffs.

SecurityBot: noted. closing the loop: INF-1429/INF-1430/INF-1441/INF-1442/INF-1443/INF-1444 recorded and assigned. next check-in in 1 week.
